PRIVACY & YOUR INFORMATION

Your Project Details.
Your Choice.

How this packaging website preview handles project briefs and saved drafts.

Updated October 21, 2026

Project inquiry information

The preview prepares a downloadable project brief in your browser. It does not send your name, contact details, message or selected file to a supplier or external form service.

Saved drafts

A draft is stored locally only when you choose Save draft. You can remove it using Clear saved draft on the form. The selected file itself is never stored in the draft.

Reference attachments

A chosen file remains on your device. The downloadable brief records its filename so you can share the file separately with the intended packaging contact.

Email and contact actions

When an actual email address is configured, an email action opens a draft in your email application for you to review and send. Company contact details are currently placeholders.

Cookies and analytics

The website uses no advertising or analytics trackers. Locally hosted product images, videos and fonts are supplied with the website.
